Global (All).title: Conflict in Ukraine escalates: Russia launches missile strikes on Ukraine
Global (All).summary: Tensions between Russia and Ukraine have been escalating in the past week, with Russia launching missile strikes on Ukrainian cities.

Global (All).title: Global Chip Shortage Worsens: TSMC Cuts Production Forecast
Global (All).summary: The global semiconductor shortage continues to affect multiple industries, with Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) reducing its production forecast.

Global (All).title: North Korea Conducts Missile Test: US and South Korea Respond
Global (All).summary: North Korea has conducted another missile test, leading to a response from the US and South Korea, who have condemned the action and announced increased military presence in the region.

United States.title: Riot at US Capitol Building
United States.summary: Pro-Trump rioters stormed the US Capitol building, causing destruction and injuries, amid certification of presidential election results.

United States.title: Mass shootings in California
United States.summary: At least 7 people were killed in two separate mass shootings in California, with authorities searching for motives.

United States.title: US Supreme Court rejects Trump election suit
United States.summary: The US Supreme Court rejected a lawsuit brought by former President Donald Trump seeking to overturn the results of the 2020 presidential election.

South Korea.title: Korean Navy Officer Arrested Over Murder of Fisherman
South Korea.summary: A South Korean navy officer was arrested for allegedly murdering a fisherman in a dispute over a fishing territory, highlighting tensions between the military and the fishing industry.

South Korea.title: South Korea Fears Cyber Attack Risks After Major Breach
South Korea.summary: South Korea has raised concerns over potential cyber attacks after a major breach of a government ministry, revealing sensitive information.

South Korea.title: Protests Erupt in South Korea Over Abortion Reform
South Korea.summary: Protests have broken out in South Korea over a proposed abortion reform bill, sparking controversy over women's rights and reproductive freedoms.

Japan.title: North Korea fires missile in direction of Japan
Japan.summary: North Korea fired a ballistic missile into the sea off its east coast on July 28, sparking alarm in Japan, with Seoul and Tokyo scrambling to assess the extent of the threat to regional security

Japan.title: Japan's government to revise security strategy with focus on China and North Korea
Japan.summary: Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida said on July 26 that the government will revise its national security strategy, focusing on China and North Korea, amid growing concerns about threats to the country's security

Japan.title: Japan and US to start talks on revising security pact this year
Japan.summary: Japan and the United States will start talks this year to revise their security pact, the two countries said on July 28, amid concerns in Tokyo about the growing military presence of countries including China
